name: Cook Meter
author: SpacemanProducts
description: Cook Meter: know exactly when you can go cook. A tab per AI coding agent with limits, resets and a celebration when a reset lands.

barWidget.description: One bar icon, one panel: a tab per installed AI coding agent.

schema.label: Tab order
schema.description: Comma-separated agent ids, in the order you want the tabs. Ids you leave out are appended in default order; no tab is ever hidden. Ids: claude, antigravity, grok, codex, copilot, cursor, opencode, kimi, kiro, devin, amp, plus the agents in agents-catalog.json (qwen, vibe, dsh, mcode).

schema.label: Notify above (%)
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when any agent's session or weekly limit passes this percentage.

schema.label: Show unused models
schema.description: List every model an agent can use, dimmed when unused or marked unavailable. Turn off to list only models with recent use. (Older key showAllClaudeModels still works.)

schema.label: Hide agents that aren't installed
schema.description: Only show tabs for agent CLIs found on this machine. Also available behind the gear icon in the panel, where the choice is saved to the plugin's own settings.json.

schema.label: Reset animation
schema.description: A short confetti burst over an agent's tab chip when one of its session or weekly meters resets.

schema.label: Reset sound
schema.description: Play a short cha-ching when a session or weekly meter resets.

schema.label: Open panel on reset
schema.description: When a session or weekly meter resets, briefly open the panel on that agent's tab (without taking keyboard focus) and close it after about 5 seconds.
